description: Get rebilling config for an app subscription and usage plans. Get rebilling config for an app subscription and usage plans for the authenticated sub-account. This endpoint returns the subscription and usage plans for an app.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

name: crm_getRebillingConfigForApp
